-- Authored design. UTC session and isolated source registration are prerequisites.
select trim(driver_id) as driver_id,
       lower(trim(vehicle_type)) as vehicle_type,
       case when trim(driver_rating) rlike '^[0-9]([.][0-9])?$'
            then try_cast(driver_rating as decimal(3,1)) end as driver_rating
from masar_bronze_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.drivers

-- A parsed model is not a Kafka or streaming implementation.
with parsed as (
    select from_json(raw_json,
        'event_id string, trip_id string, city string, event_ts string, synthetic boolean, location struct<lat:double,lon:double>') as e,
        _batch_id
    from masar_bronze_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.gps_events
)
select e.event_id as event_id, e.trip_id as trip_id,
       try_cast(e.event_ts as timestamp) as event_utc,
       e.location.lat as latitude, e.location.lon as longitude,
       e.synthetic as synthetic, _batch_id
from parsed

-- Receipt-grain staging. Execution is pending; source files remain unchanged.
with typed as (
    select
        trim(trip_id) as trip_id,
        trim(driver_id) as driver_id,
        case lower(trim(city))
          when 'riyadh' then 'Riyadh'
          when 'jeddah' then 'Jeddah'
          when 'dammam' then 'Dammam'
        end as city,
        try_cast(trim(start_ts) as timestamp) as start_utc,
        try_cast(trim(end_ts) as timestamp) as end_utc,
        case when trim(fare_sar) rlike '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]{1,2})?$'
             then try_cast(trim(fare_sar) as decimal(12,2)) end as fare_sar,
        case when trim(distance_km) rlike '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]{1,2})?$'
             then try_cast(trim(distance_km) as decimal(12,2)) end as distance_km,
        case when _source_file = 'correction.csv' then 2 else 1 end as source_revision,
        _source_file, _source_sha256, _batch_id, _ingested_at,
        start_ts as raw_start_ts, end_ts as raw_end_ts
    from masar_bronze_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.trips
)
select *,
    unix_timestamp(end_utc) - unix_timestamp(start_utc) as duration_seconds,
    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(start_utc, 'Asia/Riyadh')) as trip_date_local
from typed

left anti join masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_trips t on g.trip_id = t.trip_id

-- Source freshness alone would miss null or future arrival timestamps.
select trip_id from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_trips
where _ingested_at is null or _ingested_at > current_timestamp() + interval 5 minutes
   or _batch_id is null or _batch_id = ''
   or _source_sha256 is null or not _source_sha256 rlike '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

union all
select driver_id from masar_bronze_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.drivers
where _ingested_at is null or _ingested_at > current_timestamp() + interval 5 minutes
union all
select _batch_id from masar_bronze_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.gps_events
where _ingested_at is null or _ingested_at > current_timestamp() + interval 5 minutes

-- Content conflicts are not ordinary duplicate receipts.
select trip_id, source_revision
from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_trips
group by trip_id, source_revision
having count(distinct to_json(named_struct(
    'driver_id',driver_id,'city',city,'start',start_utc,'end',end_utc,
    'fare',fare_sar,'distance',distance_km))) > 1

-- Singular test: any returned row is a failure. Never silently discard it.
select trip_id from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_trips
where trip_id is null or trip_id = '' or city is null
   or start_utc is null or end_utc is null or end_utc <= start_utc
   or fare_sar is null or fare_sar < 0
   or distance_km is null or distance_km <= 0
   or _source_file is null or _source_file not in ('trips.csv', 'late_trips.csv', 'correction.csv')
   or not trim(raw_start_ts) rlike '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(Z|[+-](0[0-9]|1[0-4]):[0-5][0-9])$'
   or not trim(raw_end_ts) rlike '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(Z|[+-](0[0-9]|1[0-4]):[0-5][0-9])$'

-- Rank the full receipt history BEFORE the incremental ingestion-time filter.
-- Pre-merge tests reject same-revision conflicts; this ranking never hides them.
with enriched as (
    select t.*, d.vehicle_type, d.driver_rating,
        sha2(to_json(named_struct(
          'driver_id', t.driver_id, 'city', t.city,
          'start_utc', t.start_utc, 'end_utc', t.end_utc,
          'fare_sar', t.fare_sar, 'distance_km', t.distance_km,
          'vehicle_type', d.vehicle_type, 'driver_rating', d.driver_rating)), 256) as _payload_hash
    from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_trips t
    left join masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.stg_drivers d using (driver_id)
), ranked as (
    select *, row_number() over (
      partition by trip_id order by source_revision desc, _ingested_at desc,
      _source_sha256 asc, _batch_id asc) as receipt_rank
    from enriched
)
select trip_id, driver_id, city, start_utc, end_utc, trip_date_local,
       fare_sar, distance_km, duration_seconds, vehicle_type, driver_rating,
       source_revision, _source_file, _source_sha256, _ingested_at, _payload_hash
from ranked where receipt_rank = 1

-- One current row per trip. Look back on ingestion time, not trip event date.
-- A late June trip must not disappear because the session is run in September.
with candidates as (
    select * from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.int_trip_candidates
    
    where _ingested_at >= (
      select coalesce(max(_ingested_at), cast('1970-01-01 00:00:00' as timestamp))
             - interval 3 days from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.silver_trips
    )
    
)
select s.* from candidates s

left join masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.silver_trips t on s.trip_id = t.trip_id
where t.trip_id is null or s.source_revision > t.source_revision

-- Small learner-facing aggregate built from Silver, not receipt-grain staging.
select trip_date_local, city, count(*) as trip_count,
       cast(sum(fare_sar) as decimal(16,2)) as total_fare_sar
from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.silver_trips
group by trip_date_local, city

select trip_date_local, city from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.mart_city_daily
group by trip_date_local, city having count(*) != 1

-- Global totals must reconcile even though mart and fact have different grains.
with silver as (
 select count(*) as n, coalesce(sum(fare_sar),0) as fare from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.silver_trips
), mart as (
 select coalesce(sum(trip_count),0) as n, coalesce(sum(total_fare_sar),0) as fare
 from masar_dbt_2be5afa6e0fe49a5.mart_city_daily
)
select silver.n from silver cross join mart
where silver.n != mart.n or silver.fare != mart.fare
